notes.title: Update 8/22/2025 (Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Update 8/22/2025

This update focuses on improving stability, fixing critical bugs, and enhancing performance.

Bug Fixes

Fixed UI bug with the map not updating correctly.

Fixed an issue with auto-aim rotation being tied to FPS, causing rough aiming.

Fixed a bug that caused the player to fall under the map when grabbed by enemies (Power Room and Chapter 3).

Fixed UI issue that caused the inventory to stop working properly after cutscenes.

Fixed weapon issues in Chapter 3 (crossbow and grenades not functioning correctly).

Fixed cutscene functionality that previously caused errors.

Additions / Improvements

The game is no longer capped at 60 FPS, allowing smoother gameplay on high-refresh monitors.

Switched to DirectX 12 API for improved stability and URP compatibility (DirectX 11 support discontinued).

notes.title: H.A.D.E.S ZERO at Haru Fest 2025
notes.notes: [p]On August 3rd, we had the chance to showcase [b]H.A.D.E.S ZERO[/b] at [b]Haru Fest[/b] in Costa Rica! It was a great experience sharing the game directly with new players, hearing their reactions, and watching them connect with Nick, Mike… and the horrors within the H.A.D.E.S Caronte complex.[/p][p]To celebrate, the game is now [b]on sale until August 11th[/b]![/p][p]If you haven’t played this survival horror game inspired by '90s classics yet — now’s your chance.[/p][p]Thank you for supporting indie horror[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598695/ff0567a4463591b92d37d9c0bc59a6ee6abeb528.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A space to talk with the developer
notes.notes:
[p]I'd love to spend some time with you, offering [b][i]questions[/i][/b], [b][i]suggestions[/i][/b], and [b][i]discussions[/i][/b] [b][i]about the story or its development.
[/i][/b][/p][p]I'd also like to inform you that a [b][i]full beta is available[/i][/b] in the beta section. You can download it as an optional upgrade to enjoy a [b][i]preview version of H.A.D.E.S. ZERO.[/i][/b] 

To download it, do the following:[/p][p]- On Steam, go to the gear or right-click and select properties.[/p][p]- Go to "Betas."[/p][p]- In the beta participation section, select "Beta Game - Beta Game Pre-Launch ."
[/p][p]In this beta, there are various sections and documents that recount other events or explain other situations; however, many current elements are missing.[/p]
